name: Snapped Grid Extent Quantization
aliases: sg-eq (Scion layout with snapped-grid extent quantization)
definition: A BVH layout using aggressive compression via 10-bit fixed-point encoding relative to a global coordinate frame anchored at the root.
summary: Snapped Grid Extent Quantization compresses BVH bounding boxes into 12-byte nodes using 10-bit fixed-point integers and directed rounding for watertight dequantization.
